summary: Chat keyboard-inset fix verified against public preview URL (frontend only). Logged in as josh-ankermann / pw12345, opened Team-Chat, and simulated the mobile-browser soft keyboard by patching window.visualViewport.height to 420 and dispatching 'resize'. The useWebKeyboardInset hook fires and the input bar's paddingBottom expands so the actual interactive elements (chat-input, chat-send) shift upward by exactly innerH-vvH (= 424px in the 844→420 simulation) and remain fully within the visible viewport. All chat regressions PASS. One item could not be re-verified: 'Route button on away games' — the current Termine data contained no away games with maps-{id} testIDs at test time (0 elements) so the button was not present to click; this is a data condition, not a code defect. Console still emits pre-existing shadow*/pointerEvents RN 0.81 deprecation warnings.

acceptance_results.keyboard_inset_lifts_input: PASS — with visualViewport shrunk to 420px, chat-input bounding box moved from y=782 (bottom 836) to y=358 (bottom 412); chat-send bottom moved from 836 to 412. Both remain inside the visible viewport (0..420). Delta = 424px = innerH(844) − vvH(420) − offsetTop(0), which matches the hook's `Math.max(0, innerHeight - vv.height - vv.offsetTop)` formula plus spacing.sm padding on the container.
acceptance_results.input_bar_container_covers_kb_area: PASS — outer testID='chat-input-bar' expands its paddingBottom to fill the space the browser gave back so the visible interactive row sits directly above the simulated keyboard edge (bar box y=349, height=495, bottom=844; children rendered near top of that box due to paddingBottom=webKbInset+spacing.sm).
acceptance_results.typing_and_send: PASS — typed 'TEST_kbfix_<ts>' into chat-input, pressed chat-send, new bubble with the same text appeared in the conversation shortly after (verified in body innerText). POST /api/messages implicitly succeeded (no error, bubble rendered).
acceptance_results.attach_row_toggle: PASS — attach row hidden by default (attach-image count=0). Tapping chat-attach shows attach-image + attach-document (both count=1). Attach row Y (726) < input-bar Y (773) confirming it sits directly above the input bar and does not overlap. Second tap on chat-attach hides the row again (count back to 0).
acceptance_results.desktop_web_no_keyboard: PASS — with visualViewport=innerHeight (no keyboard), chat-input-bar bottom = 844 = window.innerHeight; input bar sits at the very bottom of the viewport with safe-area+spacing.sm padding (webKbInset=0 branch active).
acceptance_results.route_button_regression_on_termine: NOT VERIFIABLE IN CURRENT DATA — 0 elements matching [data-testid^='maps-'] found on the Termine tab at test time (iteration_2 saw 6, but the current listing has no away games with venue address to render the Route button). The button component in /app/frontend/src/components/EventCard.tsx (line 95) and /app/frontend/app/event/[id].tsx (line 120) is unchanged, so no code regression is present; this is just an absence of qualifying events in the current data snapshot.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Emitted on chat and other screens. Not introduced by this change; already flagged in iteration_2.
props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Emitted on login/termine transitions. Not introduced by this change; already flagged in iteration_2.

action_items: None blocking. Optionally seed at least one upcoming away event with a venue address so the 'Route' button regression on Termine can be re-verified automatically in future testing iterations.
Optional cleanup (carry-over from iteration_2): migrate remaining `shadow*` style props to `boxShadow` and `props.pointerEvents` to `style.pointerEvents` in styles/components.
critical_code_review_comments: useWebKeyboardInset: correctly gates on Platform.OS === 'web', reads visualViewport, and uses Math.max(0, innerH - vv.height - vv.offsetTop) so it stays at 0 when no keyboard is up — desktop web branch verified live.
Both 'resize' and 'scroll' listeners on visualViewport are subscribed and cleaned up in the effect return — no leak.

Applying the inset as paddingBottom on the input bar (rather than transform: translateY) means the container grows and pushes the FlatList content region up, so the last message stays visible; the useEffect on webKbInset also calls scrollToEnd — good UX detail.
keyboardVerticalOffset={insets.top + 44} matches the header total height (insets.top + spacing.sm + header content) — reasonable for native iOS/Android where KeyboardAvoidingView handles the shift.
behavior='translate-with-padding' is the correct react-native-keyboard-controller value for Android and other non-iOS platforms; iOS uses classic 'padding'.
